content:
The test image shows soybean stems with prominent reddish-brown to dark brown lesions on the lower stems, affecting multiple plants near the soil line. The lesions appear extensive and girdling. Top candidates: **Phytophthora** (dark brown lesion from taproot extending up), **Rhizoctonia** (reddish-brown lesions at soil line), or **Anthracnose** (red/dark brown blotches on stems).

Let me view the Phytophthora reference to confirm.

The Phytophthora reference (bottom-right panel) shows a dark brown girdling lesion on the lower stem near a node — this matches the test image closely. The test image shows:
- Reddish-brown to dark brown stem lesions on lower stems
- Lesions appear to girdle/extend along the stem from near the base
- Multiple affected plants showing similar dying-from-the-base-up pattern
- Stem discoloration consistent with vascular/cortex browning characteristic of Phytophthora
